primary.title: SOA vs demat account: Which option is better for mutual fund investors after SEBI's latest move?
primary.summary: SEBI’s move to allow standing instructions for SWP and STP facilities on demat-held mutual fund units is a significant step towards improving investor convenience. While SOA may offer lower costs, demat provides consolidated portfolio management and a single nomination facility for investors.
